values.note: The town: 'Looking to rent an RV space? Please contact Tommy Sugg for Reservations and Information.' Reservation line 252-560-7828. Extended stays offered (tourism listing).

booking.source: https://www.grifton.com/rentanrvspace ('Contentnea Creekside RV Park and Walking Trails', 'Reservation line: 252-560-7828'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.visitgreenvillenc.com/listing/contentnea-creekside-rv-park-&-walking-trails/273/ (Greenville-Pitt County tourism listing, a secondary source: '10 hookup sites for recreational vehicles and campers with 3 pull through sites. Extended stay and shaded areas, 30 amp and 20 amp powered hookups'), read 2026-10-22. Water and sewer at the site (derived from note prose) are stated by neither the town nor the listing: cleared.

values.note: 10 hookup sites (3 pull-through) plus 'many primitive camping sites'.

sites.source: https://www.visitgreenvillenc.com/listing/contentnea-creekside-rv-park-&-walking-trails/273/ (Greenville-Pitt County tourism listing, a secondary source: 'The park has many primitive camping sites, 10 hookup sites for recreational vehicles and campers with 3 pull through sites'), read 2026-10-22. The ~70-ft max (derived from note prose) is stated by neither the town nor the listing: cleared.

values.note: An air-conditioned restroom and bathhouse (tourism listing); fire pits, picnic tables, walking trail, fishing.

facilities.source: https://www.visitgreenvillenc.com/listing/contentnea-creekside-rv-park-&-walking-trails/273/ (Greenville-Pitt County tourism listing, a secondary source: 'an air-conditioned restroom and bathhouse', 'hiking trail, fishing, fire pits, picnic tables'), read 2026-10-22. Showers and a dump station (derived from note prose) are stated by neither the town nor the listing: cleared.

season.source: https://www.grifton.com/rentanrvspace and the tourism listing say nothing about a season; the derived year-round value (note prose) had no operator source: cleared, read 2026-10-22

note: Town of Grifton RV park along Contentnea Creek, with primitive sites besides the hookup sites, a walking trail, fishing, fire pits and picnic tables. Reservations by phone with the town. --Claude
summary: The Town of Grifton's own page says only that RV spaces are reserved by phone (252-560-7828); the rest comes from the county tourism listing (reported): 10 hookup sites, 3 pull-through, 30/20-amp, primitive sites, bathhouse. Cleared derived water/sewer, ~70-ft max, showers, dump and year-round, which no operator or listing page states. Note rewritten without the field facts. No rate published anywhere official (Campendium's $30 is from 2023).
flags: Website is a tourism listing (visitgreenvillenc.com); the operator's own page is the Town of Grifton's https://www.grifton.com/rentanrvspace (thin: a reservation contact only).
Missing phone: the town's reservation line is 252-560-7828 (https://www.grifton.com/rentanrvspace; the tourism listing gives the same).
No rate published by the town (the only figure, Campendium's $30, was reported 2023-08-18). Town park, so the private presence/price rules don't apply.
